boundary: This review establishes that the bound linkage and actions records and the listed reports agree with the public source at the named commits for the 69 scoped actions, as read by this reviewer. It does not establish runtime emitter fidelity, source-to-bytecode identity, SphereX engine behaviour, completeness of observed execution, reviewer identity or protocol safety.

method: Rebuilt each accepted input's source tree read-only from the public wildcat-protocol commits (da74452a, 6164ddd4, 488b30d0 plus submodules), confirmed the files hash to sources.json, and read every scoped action's modifiers, helpers, inherited code and cross-contract callees against its linkage row. Resolved every source_ref and event emit site by script, checked assembly topics by keccak and emitters against the denominator catalogues, spot-checked read paths and families, and re-read the X-Ray reports and the rendered architecture diagram against source after each fix.

visual_inspection.observations: Rendered with rsvg-convert -w 2262 (2262x796); the PNG is byte-identical to evidence/xray-svg-render-review-fix-3.png. All seven contexts are shown, with four actors and three externals; MarketLens sits in the actor row. The SVG has 18 edge paths with one arrowhead each; every edge joins adjacent or same rows and none crosses a box. Each of the 18 labels sits on its own edge and every edge states a relation the source supports. Two close spots stay unambiguous: 'registers market' and the 'registers controller' hook share an arrowhead point on WildcatArchController, which both target, and the market-to-engine curve grazes the top of the 'checks sanctions' label while each label stays on its own curve.
